arabic_text: فَإ نّي أعْلَمُ أنَّهُ لا مَوْلى أعْظَمُ مِنْكَ طَوْلا،
english_text: I certainly know that there is no master more generous than You,

arabic_text: وَ أوْسَعُ رَحْمَةً وَ عَفْواً،
english_text: with greater mercy and forgiveness.

arabic_text: فَيا مَنْ هُوَ أوْحَدُ في رَحْمَتِهِ،
english_text: Then, O He Who is unique in His mercy!

arabic_text: إغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَيْسَ بِأوْحَدَ في خَطيئَتِهِ،
english_text: Forgive him, who is not unique in his mistakes.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أمَرْتَنا فَعَصَيْنا،
english_text: O Allah! Certainly, You commanded us, but we have disobeyed,

arabic_text: وَ نَهَيْتَ فَمَا انْتَهَيْنا،
english_text: forbade us, but we did not desist,

arabic_text: وَ ذَكَّرْتَ فَتَناسَيْنا،
english_text: reminded us, but we remained unmindful,

arabic_text: وَ بَصَّرْتَ فَتَعامَيْنا،
english_text: enlightened us, but we behaved blindly,

arabic_text: وَ حَذَّرْتَ فَتَعَدَّيْنا،
english_text: and warned us, but we transgressed.

arabic_text: وَ ما كانَ ذلِكَ جَزآءَ إحْسانِكَ إلَيْنا،
english_text: This was not the repayment of Your kindness to us,

arabic_text: وَ أنْتَ أعْلَمُ بِما أعْلَنّا وَ أخْفَيْنا،
english_text: and You know what we have disclosed and have concealed,

arabic_text: وَ أخْبَرُ بِما نَأْتي وَ ما أتَيْنا،
english_text: and You are aware of what we will do and have done.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: fašalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: Thus, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: وَ لا تُؤاخِذْنا بِما أخْطَأْنا وَ نَسينا،
transliteration: wa lā tu'ākhidhnā bimā 'akhta'nā wa nasīnā,
english_text: and pardon us for our mistakes and our forgetfulness,

arabic_text: وَ هَبْ لَنا حُقُوقَكَ لَدَيْنا،
english_text: forgive us the negligence of Your rights by us,

arabic_text: وَ أتِمَّ إحْسانَكَ إلَيْنا،
english_text: complete Your beneficence towards us,

arabic_text: وَ أسْبِلْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْنا،
english_text: and cause Your mercy to descend upon us.

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِهذَا الصِّدّيقِ الإمامِ،
english_text: My Allah! We seek nearness to You by means of this truthful Imam,

arabic_text: وَ نَسْئَلُكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذي جَعَلْتَةُ لَهُ وَ لِجَدِّهِ رَسُولِكَ وَ لِأبَوَيْهِ عَلِيٍّ وَ فاطِمَةَ، أهْلِ بَيْتِ الرَّحْمَةِ،
transliteration: wa nas'aluka bil ħaqqil-ladhi jaaltahu lah wa lijaddihi rasūlika wa li 'abawayhi aliyyin wa fāţimata 'ahli baytir-raħmah,
english_text: and request You by the rights that You have placed for him, his grandfather, his parents, Ali and Fatima, the household of mercy,

arabic_text: إدْرارَ الرِّزْقِ الَّذي بِهِ قِوامُ حَياتِنا وَ صَلاحُ أحْوالِ عِيالِنا،
transliteration: 'idrārar-rizqil-lladhi bihī qiwāmu ħayātinā, wa šalāħu 'aħwāli iyālinā,
english_text: an abundant flow of livelihood that maintains our life and the welfare of our dependents.

arabic_text: فَأنْتَ الْكَريمُ الَّذي تُعْطي مِنْ سِعَةٍ،
english_text: Certainly You are the generous one who grants abundantly,

arabic_text: وَ تَمْنَعُ مِنْ قُدْرَةٍ،
english_text: and holds back having power (to fulfill).

arabic_text: وَ نَحْنُ نَسْئَلُكَ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ مايَكُونُ صَلاحاً لِلدُّنْيا وَ بَلاغاً لِلآخِرَةِ،
transliteration: wa naħnu nas'aluka minar-rizqi mā yakūnu šalāhan liddunyā wa balāghan lil ākhirah,
english_text: We request from You a livelihood that brings the goodness of this world and the pleasure of the hereafter,

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: allāhumma šalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: O Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: وَ اغْفِرْلَنا وَ لِوالِدَيْنا،
english_text: and forgive me, my parents,

arabic_text: وَ لِجَميعِ الْمُؤْمِنينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِناتِ،
english_text: all the believing men and women,

arabic_text: وَالْمُسْلِمينَ وَ الْمُسْلِماتِ،
english_text: and the submissive men and women,

arabic_text: الأحْياءِ مِنْهُمْ وَ الأمْواتِ،
english_text: the living of them and the dead.

arabic_text: وَ آتِنا فِي الدُّنْيا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنا عَذابَ النّارِ.
transliteration: wa ātinā fid-dunyā ħasanatan wa fil ākhirati ħasanatan wa qinā adhāban-nār.
english_text: Give us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and shield us from the torment of the fire.[1]

arabic_text: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ للهِِ وَ لا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ وَ اللهُ أكْبَرُ
transliteration: subħānal-lāhi wal ħamdulil-lāhi wa lā 'ilāha 'illal-lāhu wal-lāhu akbar,
english_text: Glory be to Allah! Praise be to Allah! There is no deity but Allah! Allah is greater (than being described).
